verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser states it serves business clients at scale, including hospital systems, large manufacturers, multinationals, tech companies and startups. It also runs an employer-side I-9/E-Verify compliance practice, so handling many employees' visas through one firm is plausible. However, its startups practice is framed around founders and entrepreneurs rather than scaling teams. The Visalaw AI product is a drafting and research tool for immigration practitioners, not an employer-facing case-management system. Missing for 10: a documented multi-case or employer case-management portal, an explicit scale-up or team-hiring program beyond founder cases, and independent corroboration of high-volume employer service.
